# Logistics 0.1.2 alpha 7

- Expand Books and Comics reading parity, library navigation, speech and typography controls.
- Consolidate rclone workflows with transfer review, retry handling, remote browsing and direct readers.
- Keep multiple saved and session-only credential packages side by side, with separate privacy gates and remote identities.
- Improve mobile storage navigation, privacy controls, reader gestures, fullscreen behavior and tablet viewport sizing.
- Include native Android/iOS validation and portable Windows review fixtures.

The iOS TestFlight application version is 0.1.6. GitHub publication requires all desktop platform, native mobile and mobile runtime checks to pass. This candidate includes the latest shared and application changes and supersedes the unpublished alpha 1 through 6 candidates.
